cases.title: a Secret too short to mask: 78, the remedies, nothing started

expect.stderr:
varlatch: this Secret is shorter than 8 bytes, so its value cannot be masked in the command's output: PIN
  Leave PIN out only if the command's code or documentation shows that the command does not use it (no approval needed):
      varlatch --assisted run -e dev --omit PIN -- <command>
    Then name PIN left out in your answer, and say whether the task itself was done: getting past this refusal does not show that the command did what was asked.
  If you are not sure, or the command uses PIN, stop and ask the human what to do about PIN. Approval for one item or action never covers another.
  - Only if they approve replacing PIN with a new random value (it overwrites the current one):
      varlatch --assisted values set PIN -e dev --replace PIN --generate hex:32
    A credential a provider issued is never generated: the human enters it, in their own terminal: varlatch values set PIN -e dev
  - Only if they approve marking PIN as not secret (a Contract change, for the whole project): varlatch --assisted agents guide contract
  - Showing it unmasked is the human's alone, in their own terminal (assisted mode refuses it; every other Secret stays masked):
      varlatch run -e dev --allow-unmasked PIN -- <command>
Nothing was started.
